faq.a: Memet is associated with the Arabic form مَحَمَّد, whose core sense is memet; muhammad (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Memet?
faq.a: Memet is associated with Arabic. Memet is a Turkish form of Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad), meaning 'praised'.
Yes — the underlying form مَحَمَّد is Arabic.
Memet can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Memet should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Muḥammad is not a Quranic personal name, though the root ح م د is Quranic.

faq.q: What does Memet mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Memet is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، تعریف شدہ.

faq.q: What does Memet mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Memet is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، ستوده.
A romanized syllable approximation is me-met. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Memet?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Memet, memet. Script forms are محمد, مَحَمَّد, मेमेत.

faq.q: Is Memet a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
